objective: Act on the architecture audit of the web Planner: one honestly-scoped status vocabulary, a reachable guided walkthrough, persistence that never reports a success it did not achieve, observational studies able to finish the workflow, harmonized AI-provenance language, and a zero-install test suite that can reach the lifecycle and UI code where all of those defects live.
invariants: ZERO-INSTALL: no npm, no node_modules, no new dependency, ever. web/package.json stays {"type":"module","private":true}.
Baseline to beat: 761 JS tests (node --test web/tests/*.test.js) and 52 Python tests, all green. Run BOTH suites: a duplicate top-level symbol breaks only the Python build test.
The single-file build rejects duplicate top-level symbols across modules (tests/test_single_file_build.py:83-109). Every new top-level name must be module-prefixed.
No top-level await anywhere in web/src -- the single-file inliner forbids it.
Executors never run git commit, git push, or open a PR.
Read docs/cma-lessons.md before starting and apply it unprompted.
